# Indus Valley script research knowledge base

> A research knowledge base testing whether shared evidence and recorded evaluation can support measurable progress on the Indus script and its archaeology. It preserves source-linked observations, experiments, failures, manuscripts and testable conjectures. Complete objects and metadata are the first priority; acquired corpora remain local and no reading or language has been established.

## Agent entry

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/k-sandhu/indus-valley-script/blob/86ad64f6cfe487295d9f7588b77910bef6138134/AGENTS.md): the starting rules and task routes.
- [Repository map](https://github.com/k-sandhu/indus-valley-script/blob/86ad64f6cfe487295d9f7588b77910bef6138134/knowledge/MAP.md): generated inventory of cards, studies and papers.

## Evidence and working ideas

- [Data coverage](https://k-sandhu.github.io/indus-valley-script/data.html): held inputs, missing fields and acquisition priorities.
- [Working model](https://k-sandhu.github.io/indus-valley-script/working-model/index.html): current conjectures and deciding tests.

## People and contribution

- [README](https://k-sandhu.github.io/indus-valley-script/index.html): purpose, measured results and exploration.
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://k-sandhu.github.io/indus-valley-script/contribute/index.html): ownership, claims and independent verification.
